For a buyer the practical points are the form bought, the basis a result is reported on, where the grape Juice came from and the laboratory’s reporting limit. Testing finds contamination but does not remove it.

<div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-grape-juice" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-grape-juice-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of grape juice, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Held rows failed a check against their own source and are shown but not compared.</p>

In one study, lead across 168 groups of grape Juice ranged from 0.6 µg/kg (FY2018) to 39.8 µg/kg (FY2011); the lowest is the lowest observed in that study, not an established sourcing preference.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2018-lead-in-juice-fy2005-fy2018|8]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2018-lead-in-juice-fy2005-fy2018">Analytical Results for Lead in Juice Sampled Under the FDA&#39;s Toxic Elements in Food and Foodware, and Radionuclides in Food – Import and Domestic Compliance Program (FY2005-FY2018)</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA analytical results table</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2018-lead-in-juice-fy2005-fy2018">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In another study, lead across 5 groups of grape Juice ranged from 2 µg/kg (imported nectar, producer code L (sample 2)) to 8 µg/kg (locally produced nectar, producer code B (sample 1)); the lowest is the lowest observed in that study, not an established sourcing preference.<sup class="cite">[[sources/alzagtat2016-fruit-nectars-libya-heavy-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Alzagtat AA, Eledody RY · 2016</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/alzagtat2016-fruit-nectars-libya-heavy-metals">Conformity of Fruit Nectar Samples to Libyan Specification Standards</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Turkish Journal of Agriculture - Food Science and Technology</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/alzagtat2016-fruit-nectars-libya-heavy-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

## Grape Juice FAQs

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-grape-juice" data-anchor="what-heavy-metals-are-found-in-grape-juice" data-question="What heavy metals are found in grape Juice?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What heavy metals are found in grape Juice?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

The library reports lead, cadmium, total arsenic, inorganic arsenic, dimethylarsinic acid, monomethylarsonic acid, total mercury, nickel, chromium, aluminium, tin, uranium, Co, Cu, Fe, Zn, AsIII and AsV in grape Juice, most often lead, cadmium and total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/alzagtat2016-fruit-nectars-libya-heavy-metals|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Alzagtat AA, Eledody RY · 2016</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/alzagtat2016-fruit-nectars-libya-heavy-metals">Conformity of Fruit Nectar Samples to Libyan Specification Standards</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Turkish Journal of Agriculture - Food Science and Technology</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/alzagtat2016-fruit-nectars-libya-heavy-metals">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/balalimood2018-fruit-juice-mashhad-pb-as|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Mahdi Balali-Mood, Bamdad Riahi-Zanjani, Adeleh Mahdizadeh, Valiallah Moradi, Rana Fazeli-Bakhtiyari · 2018</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/balalimood2018-fruit-juice-mashhad-pb-as">Arsenic and Lead Contaminations in Commercial Fruit Juices of Markets in Mashhad, Iran</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Iranian Journal of Toxicology</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/balalimood2018-fruit-juice-mashhad-pb-as">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> WHO GEMS/Food submissions reported lead in grape Juice, juice from 377 results in 4 reporting regions, with subgroup medians from 3.5 to 50.8 µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">World Health Organization · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">GEMS/Food Contaminants database heavy-metal exports</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">GEMS/Food Contamination Monitoring and Assessment Programme</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/who-gemsfood-heavy-metal-contaminants">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>
